ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigation into the alleged $9B Medicaid fraud in Minnesota, with a focus on following the money trail
questions: What is the extent of the Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a large-scale fraud scheme, with significant financial implications. By following the money trail, we may be able to identify key players and uncover the extent of the fraud.
